name: Cleaning Business Management System in Excel – Profit per Client
html:
See which clients really make money after pay, supplies and travel, who is paying late and which crew is about to be overloaded – before you quote the next job or take on the next hire. This is a complete back office for a residential and commercial cleaning company in Excel: eight connected workbooks that already work with sample data, so you see every alert and dashboard before you type your first client.

Built for owners with an office coordinator, team leads and cleaners in crews, cleaning homes, offices, rental turnovers, move-outs and post-construction sites for paying clients.

What you get:

  • 8 connected workbooks: quotes, pricing and rate cards; clients, schedules and routes; crews, hours, pay and capacity; job checklists and quality inspections; supplies, equipment and cost per job; invoices, payments and late payers; complaints, reviews and office contracts; job profit, cash flow and taxes
  • 552 ready pages: dashboards, calculators, printable forms and checklists, and ready WhatsApp messages
  • 15 languages, each as a blank template, with filled sample-data copies in English
  • Standard xlsx files for Microsoft Excel and LibreOffice – no macros, no subscription

How it works: 1) open the workbook in your language, 2) type your clients, jobs, hours, supplies and payments in the yellow cells, 3) quote prices, schedules, crew load, inspection scores, late-payer flags and profit per client update by themselves. One payment, instant download.

What it does for you

  • Price every quote right from the area, rooms, frequency and add-ons
  • Know the lowest price worth taking after pay, supplies and travel
  • See every recurring visit and the next date, and never miss one
  • Plan each crew day with free hours and routes with arrival times
  • Know when to hire from crew hours, waiting clients and overtime
  • Pay crews right with overtime and quality bonus from your own rules
  • Score every job against a checklist and coach where jobs fail
  • See the real supplies, travel and labour cost of every job
  • Never run out of stock and know when each machine needs service
  • Chase late payers with a reminder ladder and an aging report
  • Renew office contracts on time and see the cost of complaints and re-cleans
  • See profit per client and service, and cash 12 months ahead with taxes set aside

Do I need special software?
No. The files are standard xlsx files for Microsoft Excel and LibreOffice, which is free.

Does it fit a small crew and a larger company?
Yes. It works for an owner with one crew and for a company with several crews; the sample data shows an owner, an office coordinator, two team leads, six cleaners in three crews, about 120 clients in four areas and about 3,900 jobs.

Can I replace the sample data with my own?
Yes. Every workbook comes in 15 languages as a blank template, plus filled sample-data copies in English, so you can explore first and start clean when you are ready. Each fact is typed once and every dashboard reads it from there.

Can I use my own currency, rates and targets?
Yes. Currency, rates per labour hour, add-on prices, area surcharges, target margin, overtime multiplier, due days and pass mark are on the settings and list sheets, and every formula follows your changes.

Where do I start?
Start with Part 1 for quotes and prices, or with the part that hurts most today, such as late payers or schedules. Each workbook works alone and links to the others as you fill it.

Are there macros or a subscription, and how do I receive it?
No macros and no subscription. You pay once and download a ZIP at once with every workbook in all 15 languages.
seo: Run your cleaning company from 8 connected Excel workbooks: quotes, schedules, crews, inspections, supplies, invoices, contracts and profit. 15 languages.
